blocking_findings.title: Reject symlinked ancestor directories before reading source/XML
blocking_findings.contract: packet Required behavior: current tracked validated Java identity; Directory scope stale cross-task artifact/race prevention; author states no source symlink or linked report content read.
blocking_findings.observation: Path.is_symlink() tests the final component only. For a regular file behind a symlinked parent, it is false. source_registry reads it without checking canonical source scope. XML reader accepts a canonical path anywhere beneath checkout root, including another task/module reached through a linked selected result directory.
blocking_findings.impact: Collector can read outside-checkout source bytes and can attach the current selected task/service metadata and source identities to XML from a different task. Such outcomes cannot establish the required current-case execution. No actual production leak/remote mislabelling was executed or claimed.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Reject symlinked ancestor source/report directories and ensure reads remain beneath the canonical selected source/result scope before reading/hashing. Add targeted controls for source parent links and report directory links within/outside the checkout, including cross-task task metadata. Preserve raw-value privacy and workflow gates. Record source/control hashes before the newly justified correction validation.
